en: The Triplet on the Visible and the Dyad on the Internal.
Dependent on an internal state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive,
nor internal, by way of root-condition. Dependent on an internal state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive,
there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable-and-reactive nor internal, by way of root-condition … pe … dependent on an internal state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive.

Dependent on phenomena that are non-visible-and-non-reacting and not internal, as well as phenomena that are non-visible-and-non-reacting and not internal, [other] phenomena arise by way of the root condition.
(Abbreviated. Six for the root condition; three for the object condition ... pe ... six for the non-disappearance condition.

Dependent on an external phenomenon that is non-visible-but-reacting, a phenomenon arises that is non-visible-and-non-reacting and not external by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Eleven for the root condition; three for the object condition ... pe ... eleven for the non-disappearance condition.
